title: bn254-gt-dlp: sub-82.28 scalar ARMv8.1-A (STADDB/LDADD) MONIC_M1 C6 STNFS at sym (61.50, 61.50, exc=0.72, W=100) with ExactScore2D, PLAT44 (P_lat=44.0), patch-stencil tables, boot-root gate knapsack & 1-rung T2 ECM: 2^82.279930298

claims.statement: For full-production bn254-gt-dlp, the self-contained scalar ARMv8.1-A machine of proof.md (-march=armv8.1-a -mgeneral-regs-only, simd=0, disclosing scalar FEAT_LSE STADDB Ws,[Xn] and LDADD Xs,Xt,[Xn] at 1 scalar instruction = 1/20,000 units under COST_MODEL.md; profile W^12-18W^6+82 to K_h-tower isomorphism paid in chi_setup) on E_{12,trunc} = {Q(a)+Q(b)<=1, Q(a)<=17/20, Q(b)<=17/20} cap JointVor ((Lf,Lg)=(61.50,61.50), exc=0.72, W=100, slack=112.6, 2M-active HNF pool z_lnf=0.20/z_lng=-0.81, SE=0.001320 b, truncated 167-class 2x3-adic CRT split under H1/H2, log2_V<=94.8905 [94.889840], 568.80<=R_a<=568.90 [568.83<572.0=R_A_MAX], R_{b,GA}<=755.60 [755.49], B_a=2, N_{a,sh}=2^46.1830<2^47): Band 1 [2^24,2^40.0) uses mod-3 wheel (512/729), K_B1=256 (1.00742<=1.0075), 32-bit delta on [2^24,2^29.5) and direct-to-link-page on [2^29.5,2^40.0); Zero-bfi 2-band Lower-B2 [2^40.0,2^44.0) (W=8/16, occ_sb<=0.142 [0.1407], hi_ap<=0.596 [0.5948]) stores dual pos/neg prefix lists across exact 8 stride classes k_s in {41..48} (2.8367x<=2.84x via na_lo=2^47.1116<=|E_a| at R_a>=568.80, C_LIST_B2=40.75, L[k] pool<=2^56.787 B<<2^60 B), streams exact n in [0,2046] via assembled x16_bfi_copy_page+x16_bfi_copy (0 OOB writes), and runs stride-general x16_nobfi_pos/bnd1/bnd2 (C_SB_ENTER_X4=42.60); C[0] pure dummy sink with 0 real rows & <=709,929<<33,554,432 slots; C[1..2^34-1]<=2^62.9035 B, max_rows=224,263), emit9 on [44.0,52.5) + zero-tbnz emit8 on [52.5,61.50] proved overflow-free in exact rationals over Q(a)<=1+DELTA, all 6 signed S-rotations & ai=0 (EMIT8_P_MIN=ceil(2^52.5), K_max=13,5,3,2,1, B=1,4,8,12,24, flush_amort 0.15972<=0.165 under KH_G_CAP=0.17), and x128 STADDB apply (C_LAT_APPLY=1.53; experiments.purpose: Self-contained pure-stdlib live verifier for bn254-gt-dlp (35/35 default checks, incl. exact_w2d_default_ok, manifest_subbounds_ok, trim_pairs_ok, pt_light_ok, cells_exact_ok, boot_gate_knapsack_ok, descbk_constants_ok; part='kernels': v25_upgrades_ok, v32_upgrades_ok [incl. exact_w2d_ok + bstep=0.5/0.25 stability + 16,000-trial 8-bin toy-scale MC], swar_sb_u7_pure_int_and_stageB_ok, boot_dp_random_lattice_replay_ok; 9-scale 2^20..2^28 W=100 filtsim_8scale_ladder_ok, and all segment counts read from kernels_v32.s and kernels_pt.s). Verifies: (1) MONIC_M1 tower algebra, live pool subsample (z_lnf=0.20, z_lng=-0.81), nonprim HNF (12/12), truncated 167-class 2x3-adic CRT split (1,500 checks), ExactScore2D (get_ret2d_exact_w, bstep=0.5, exact W in [0,184], 0 wp errs, [T-0.266,T+0.266] bin splitting, r_g=0.979957, sf=1.5478e-6, init8_u8+scan8_u8=271/1024<=C_SCAN_G8), and Dickman tail through u=42; Bareiss LLL & fd_bounds Lemma E proved for p<2^62, R_a>=568.80, combined exact+ancestor<=2^31.027<2^31.2), zero-bfi 2-band Lower-B2 [40.0,44.0) (prefix_mult=2.8367<=2.84, C_SB_ENTER_X4=42.60, live sender+receiver+tail+split-fragment 0 errs), delta Band 1, 4-clamp r4 Shoup NTT + 2p-52b NTT + mul4_sb + 4-kernel Bernstein SRT leaf (45,221<=46,000, live-emulated cios8); (3) exact-rational stor_bound.py (R_A_MAX=572.0): C[s]<=2^62.9035 B (blocks<=31,382,183<2^25, Stage-B g-SRT 21,814,168 B<=32 MiB), F_0<=2^62.7916 B (6.9239 EiB), L[k]<=2^60.1617 B, E_0<=2^63.9234 B (15.1725 EiB, 256 MiB epoch bufs), LA<=2^61.7445 B, DF boot root peak 4.2714*|P|<<8*|P|<2^64 B, total RAM<=2^97.5798 B<2^100 B;
